name: The Crystal Caves
description: A network of underground caves filled with glowing crystals that pulse with a soft, ethereal light.

cave_entrance.description: You are at the mouth of a dark cave. A cool breeze carrying the scent of damp earth and minerals flows out from the entrance. The only way is east, deeper into the cave.

crystal_chamber.description: You enter a large chamber. The walls are lined with massive, glowing crystals that pulse with a soft, blue light, illuminating the cavern. Passages lead west back to the entrance and north deeper into the cave system.

underground_river.description: An underground river flows through this cavern from north to south. A set of slippery stepping stones offers a path to the east. The way back is to the south.

waterfall_grotto.description: You've found a hidden grotto behind a waterfall. The air is thick with mist and the sound of crashing water is deafening. In the center of the grotto, a large, perfectly formed crystal hums with a powerful energy. The only exit is back to the west, across the river.

heart_of_the_mountain.name: The Heart of the Mountain
heart_of_the_mountain.description: Find the source of the powerful hum deep within the Crystal Caves.
